## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and related Issue.

## Validation and remaining limits

Record the source commit and checks performed. Distinguish simulated providers,
real PostgreSQL/Temporal, live AWS, skipped checks and external user observations.

## Release scope (required for release PRs)

- [ ] Update `docs/readiness.md` with the target commit/version, evidence links,
      supported OS/configurations and known limits.
- [ ] Record enabled/restricted scope, migrations and unresolved Issues.
- [ ] Verify packaged offline course, checksum/SBOM/provenance, and failure paths.
- [ ] Confirm private security review status without disclosing report details.

For other changes, mark this section not applicable if it does not alter scope.
